---
description: >-
  Posts about software engineering research, software testing, developer
  tools, and episodes of Software Engineering Radio.
title: "Blog"
toc: true
page-layout: full
listing:
  page-size: 10
  contents:
    - "../blog/**/*.qmd"
    - "!../blog/index.qmd"
  sort:
    - "date desc"
    - "title"
  type: default
  categories: true
  date-format: "YYYY"
  sort-ui: [date]
  filter-ui: true
  fields: [date, title, reading-time, description, categories]
  feed:
    title: "Blog"
execute:
  freeze: auto
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

posts = sorted(Path(".").glob("*/index.qmd"))
question = "What else should I write about?"
print("Enjoy reading these " + str(len(posts)) + " blog posts! " + question)
```
